Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sunil Kumar Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Dhiraj Kumar Pandey Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
329 of 2021 at Police Station- Deoband, District- Saharanpur under Sections 498A, 323, 304B, IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 03.06.2021.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 27.08.2021.

The following arguments made by Shri Sunil Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Chandan Agarwal, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1.
The applicant is the husband of the deceased.

sentences.text: 2. The applicant never harassed the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
3. The applicant is bereaved by the death of his wife.
4. The postmortem report opines that cause of death could not be ascertained.
In fact the death of the deceased was by natural causes,
5. The viscera report has not been produced.
6. The ingredients to establish presumption under Section 304-B IPC are not made out.
7. The first informant who is the father of the victim and PW-2 who is the mother of the victim have repudiated the prosecution case in his testimony before the trial court.
The said witnesses have been declared hostile at the instance of the prosecution.
8. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
9. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Dhanpat Raja be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Pravin  Dhanpat Raja vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66719470/
